# Contented.io

> Contented.io is a revolutionary AI digital labor platform that replaces expensive human content teams with intelligent automation. Transform content creation from $50,000+/year writers to $19-99/month AI automation, achieving 10x faster production with 24/7 availability across 20+ languages.

Contented.io eliminates the need for content writers, SEO specialists, social media managers, and content strategists by providing:

- **AI Content Generation**: Advanced language models create SEO-optimized blog posts, articles, and social content
- **RAG Technology**: Brand-consistent content using your uploaded documents and company knowledge
- **Multi-website Management**: Scale content across unlimited brands without hiring additional staff  
- **Automated Scheduling**: Set-and-forget content pipelines with daily/weekly/monthly publishing
- **Image Intelligence**: AI-powered image selection, generation, and optimization
- **Multilingual Capabilities**: Native-level content in 20+ languages without hiring translators

The platform serves businesses looking to eliminate expensive human content teams while maintaining superior quality and consistency. Users can replace entire content departments costing $150,000-500,000+ annually with AI automation starting at just $19/month.

## Getting Started

- [Sign Up](https://contented.io/signup): Create your account and start generating content immediately
- [Pricing Plans](https://contented.io/pricing): Compare features and calculate your cost savings
- [Main Dashboard](https://contented.io/app): Access all content generation tools and website management
